delta_analysis.summary: This is the first run for OpsGrid Development with no historical baseline; all 5 accounts flagged as critical with usage drops 45-68% and inactivity gaps up to 43 days. Autonomous intervention execution achieved 100% success with zero errors, establishing a strong operational foundation for future pattern comparison.

outcome.situation_summary: All 5 accounts are CRITICAL with churn scores ranging from 80-100. VoltDesk ($10,711 MRR) is the highest-value account at risk with a -67.6% DAU drop and NPS=2. Total MRR at risk is $17,315 across accounts managed by Derek Santos, Marcus Webb, Tom Reyes, and Julia Okafor.
outcome.memory_summary: Processed 5 accounts, all flagged as critical. Primary risk patterns: usage drops >50% (3 accounts), 43-day login gap (1 account), combined usage+ticket friction (1 account). MRR at risk: $17,215 across $292-$10,711 range. All 5 interventions queued successfully with 100% autonomous execution rate and zero errors. CSM coverage complete across 4 team members. Baseline established for future comparative analysis.
